jupas.shortDescription: an class="before_label">Short Description The BEcon and BEcon&Fin programmes share the same programme code. Students are required to enrol in either one of the programmes on admission. The BEcon programme trains students in economic theories, statistical tools, the application of theories to solve practical economic problems in trade, banking, the labour market and evaluation of the regional economic performances of China, Hong Kong and other economies. Students will be furnished with solid theoretical and empirical economic knowledge to analyse and understand human behaviour and social interactions. The programme allows students a high degree of flexibility in planning their future career specialisation. Students can also declare a second major or minor(s) if they are able to meet the programme

programme.nameZh: 經濟學學士 / 經濟金融學學士
programme.name: Bachelor of Economics

admission.title: Admission Requirements & Statistics
content: - Core: English Language, Chinese Language, Mathematics, Liberal Studies

curriculum.title: Curriculum Structure
content: The Bachelor of Economics (BEcon) programme provides rigorous training in economic theories, quantitative methods, and their application to real-world issues. Students develop analytical skills to understand human behaviour, market dynamics, and policy impacts.
- Core courses in microeconomics, macroeconomics, mathematics for economists, and statistics
- Elective courses from finance, business, or other disciplines
- Advanced electives in trade, banking, labour economics, China economy
- Optional overseas exchange (one semester or full year)
- Second major or minor declaration possible
- Shared programme code with BEcon&Fin; students choose upon admission
- High flexibility to declare a second major or minor(s)
- Access to HKU Business School's global exchange network
- Strong emphasis on China and Hong Kong economic analysis

career.title: Career Prospects
content: - Economic analysis units in government departments
- Data-driven decision making in tech firms
- Master's or PhD in Economics, Finance, or related fields

campus.title: Campus Life & Facilities
content: **Main Campus – HKU Main Building & Centennial Campus:**
- State-of-the-art lecture theatres and seminar rooms
- Business School dedicated study spaces and computer labs
- Main Library with extensive economics and business collections
- Electronic resources including Bloomberg terminals and databases
- Various interest clubs and case competition teams
- Stanley Ho Sports Centre with gym, swimming pool, and courts
- University sports teams and fitness classes
- Residential halls and colleges with vibrant communities

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness & Selection Factors
content: 1. **DSE Scores (Primary):** Best 5 subjects with weighting on English, Mathematics, and best elective
2. **Interview Performance:** Assesses analytical thinking, communication, and motivation
3. **Subject Choice:** Preference for Economics, Mathematics, or other quantitative subjects
4. **OEA (Other Experiences & Achievements):** Leadership, community service, and relevant competitions
5. **Overall Profile:** Consistency between academic record and programme fit
- Target a DSE score of at least 39 (LQ) to be competitive
- Prepare for interview with current economic issues and personal goals
- Highlight any economics-related projects or work experience in OEA

alumni.title: Alumni & Faculty Excellence
content: - HKU Business School faculty are internationally recognised researchers and educators
- Active in policy advisory and corporate partnerships
- HKU Business School consistently ranked among top business schools in Asia
- Economics programme highly regarded for its rigorous training
- Centre for Economic Research and Policy
- Various research clusters in behavioural economics, trade, and development
- Graduates hold positions in leading banks, consultancies, and government agencies
- Strong alumni mentorship and networking events

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Aid
content: - Awarded based on academic merit (DSE scores, interview performance)
- Full or partial tuition coverage for top applicants
- Various scholarships for students with outstanding achievements
- Automatically considered upon JUPAS application; no separate application required
- Additional scholarships may require separate applications

tips.title: Ace Sir's BEcon Admission Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: Focus on English, Mathematics, and your best elective (each ×1.5). A 5** in these three subjects gives 51 points, while a 5* gives 45. Aim for at least 5* in each to reach the median 40.
- Prioritise revision time on these three subjects
- Use past papers to identify weak areas
Economics, M1/M2, or other quantitative subjects are preferred. They demonstrate readiness for the programme's analytical rigour.
- If your school offers Economics, take it
- M1/M2 can substitute for one elective
The interview is crucial. Prepare to discuss current economic issues (e.g., inflation, trade wars, Hong Kong's role) and your motivation for studying economics.
- Read the Economist or local financial news weekly
Leadership roles, community service, and economics-related competitions (e.g., case competitions, debate) add weight.
- Join the Economics and Finance Society or similar clubs
- Participate in the HKU Business School case competition
With median 40 and LQ 39, aim for 40 to be safe. Use the weighted formula to calculate your target scores.
- Set specific grade goals for each subject
- Use mock exams to track progress
The programme involves significant mathematics and statistics. Strengthen your foundation in calculus, probability, and data analysis.
- Review M1/M2 topics even if not taking the exam
- Practice with online resources (Khan Academy, Coursera)
Read beyond textbooks. Follow blogs, podcasts, or YouTube channels on economics. Mention specific interests in your interview or OEA.
- Write a short essay on an economic topic you find fascinating
Consider related programmes like BEcon&Fin (same code) or BBA in Finance as alternatives. They share similar curriculum and career paths.
- Apply to JS6767 as first choice, but also consider JS6781 (BBA) or JS6793 (BSc QFin)
- Ensure your backup choices are realistic based on your predicted scores
Check the HKU Business School website and JUPAS page regularly for any updates on requirements or interview arrangements.
- Bookmark the programme page and check monthly
- Attend HKU admission talks or webinars

admission.title: 入學要求及統計
content: - 核心科目：英文、中文、數學、通識教育
**面試：** 需要（獲篩選申請人）
- 中位數：40 | 下四分位數：39 | 上四分位數：40

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: 經濟學學士課程提供嚴謹的經濟理論、定量方法及其在現實問題中的應用訓練。學生將培養分析人類行為、市場動態和政策影響的能力。
- 微觀經濟學、宏觀經濟學、經濟數學、統計學核心課程
- 中級微觀經濟學及宏觀經濟學
- 計量經濟學與數據分析
- 選修金融、商業或其他學科課程
- 貿易、銀行、勞動經濟學、中國經濟等高級選修
- 可選海外交流（一學期或全年）
**四年級 – 整合與職業準備：**
- 高級研討會及研究項目
- 可申報第二主修或副修
- 職業工作坊及企業導師計劃
- 與經濟金融學士共用課程編號，入學時選擇
- 高度靈活，可申報第二主修或副修
- 可使用香港大學經管學院全球交流網絡
- 強調中國及香港經濟分析

career.title: 就業前景
content: - 政府部門經濟分析單位
- 科技公司數據驅動決策
- 經濟學、金融學或相關領域碩士或博士

campus.title: 校園生活與設施
content: **主校園 – 香港大學本部大樓及百周年校園：**
- 經管學院專用自修空間及電腦室
- 主圖書館擁有豐富經濟及商業藏書
- 電子資源包括彭博終端及數據庫
- 各類興趣學會及個案比賽隊伍
- 何世光體育中心設有健身室、泳池及球場
- 大學運動隊伍及健身課程
- 住宿學院及舍堂提供活力社群

competitiveness.title: 競爭力與甄選因素
content: 1. **DSE成績（首要）：** 最佳5科，英文、數學及最佳選修加權
2. **面試表現：** 評估分析思維、溝通能力及動機
3. **科目選擇：** 優先考慮經濟、數學或其他定量科目
4. **其他經驗及成就（OEA）：** 領導才能、社區服務及相關比賽
5. **整體檔案：** 學術記錄與課程匹配度
- 目標DSE分數至少39（下四分位數）以具競爭力
- 準備面試時討論當前經濟議題及個人目標
- 在OEA中突出經濟相關項目或工作經驗

alumni.title: 校友及學院卓越成就
content: - 港大經管學院教授為國際認可的研究人員及教育工作者
- 積極參與政策諮詢及企業合作
- 港大經管學院持續位列亞洲頂尖商學院
- 經濟學課程以嚴謹訓練聞名
- 行為經濟學、貿易及發展等研究集群
- 畢業生任職於頂尖銀行、諮詢公司及政府機構
- 強大的校友導師及聯誼活動

scholarships.title: 獎學金及財務援助
content: - 根據學術成績（DSE分數、面試表現）頒發
- 頂尖申請人可獲全額或部分學費減免
- 多項獎學金授予有傑出成就的學生
- 提供需要為本的財務援助
- 香港特別行政區政府獎學金
- 尤德爵士紀念基金獎學金
- 提交JUPAS申請時自動考慮，無需另行申請
- 部分獎學金可能需要獨立申請

tips.title: Ace Sir的經濟學入學策略 — 9個實用貼士
content: 重點放在英文、數學及最佳選修（各×1.5）。這三科取得5**可得51分，5*得45分。目標每科至少5*以達到中位數40。
- 將溫習時間集中在這三科
- 使用歷屆試題找出弱點
經濟、M1/M2或其他定量科目較受青睞，顯示你已準備好應付課程的分析要求。
- 如學校提供經濟科，應選修
面試至關重要。準備討論當前經濟議題（如通脹、貿易戰、香港角色）及你修讀經濟學的動機。
- 每週閱讀《經濟學人》或本地財經新聞
領導角色、社區服務及經濟相關比賽（如個案比賽、辯論）可增加優勢。
- 加入經濟及金融學會或類似社團
- 參加港大經管學院個案比賽
中位數40、下四分位數39，目標40分較穩妥。使用加權公式計算你的目標分數。
- 為每科設定具體等級目標
- 利用模擬考試追蹤進度
課程涉及大量數學及統計學。加強微積分、概率及數據分析基礎。
- 即使不應考M1/M2，也複習相關課題
- 使用網上資源（Khan Academy、Coursera）練習
**7. 展現對經濟學的濃厚興趣**
超越教科書閱讀。關注經濟學博客、播客或YouTube頻道。在面試或OEA中提及具體興趣。
- 撰寫一篇關於你感興趣的經濟議題的短文
考慮相關課程如經濟金融學（相同編號）或金融學工商管理學士。它們有相似的課程及就業路徑。
- 將JS6767作為首選，同時考慮JS6781（BBA）或JS6793（BSc QFin）
- 確保後備選擇基於你的預測分數而現實可行
定期查看港大經管學院網站及JUPAS頁面，了解要求或面試安排的最新變動。
- 將課程頁面加入書籤，每月檢查
- 參加港大入學講座或網絡研討會
